unit: Power: Monarchy and Democracy in Britain c.1000-2014
title: The Norman monarchy and feudal power 1066-1154

items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio walkthrough of how William I and his successors used feudalism and Domesday to grip England after 1066.

items.title: How the Normans Changed the History of Europe — Mark Robinson
items.description: TED-Ed animation on Norman methods of control — castles, feudalism, language and why it worked so well. 5 min.

items.title: Ten Minute English and British History #08 — 1066 and the Norman Conquest
items.description: Clear overview of William I's methods — Domesday Book, castle building and the feudal reorganisation of England. 10 min.

items.title: The White Queen (2013)
items.description: Later medieval English power struggles — dramatises how the Norman feudal system evolved into baronial politics.

items.title: Becket (1964)
items.description: Henry II vs Thomas Becket — the tension between royal and Church power in the Norman feudal order.

items.title: National Archives — Education Resources
items.description: The National Archives holds Domesday Book and Norman period records — primary source packs for GCSE.
